svg.title: Glazier — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as glazier, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A glass pane is held by a two-cup suction lifter with a raised connecting handle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
